cancelAction.description: Generic cancel button label for in-progress actions

closeButton.description: Button text for close button, which hides the toolbar

h2dCaptureTitle.description: Title for the HTML to Design capture toolbar

h2dCapturePreviewAlt.description: Alt text for the capture preview thumbnail image

h2dCapturePageButton.description: Button text to capture the full page as Figma layers

h2dCapturingText.description: Loading text shown while capturing a page

h2dDismissAllButton.description: Button text to discard all captures

h2dCaptureCodeButton.description: Action that saves the current tab as an MHTML code capture in the capture tray.

h2dCaptureCodeTooLarge.message: This page is too large to capture code.
h2dCaptureCodeTooLarge.description: Shown when the MHTML archive or its message exceeds the capture size limit.

h2dCaptureCodeUnavailable.message: Code capture is not available on this page.
h2dCaptureCodeUnavailable.description: Shown for unsupported tabs or missing capture context.

h2dSelectElementButton.description: Button text to select a specific element on the page

h2dCaptureScrollAreaButton.description: Button text to explicitly select one vertically scrollable page region and capture all of its content

selectScrollAreaToCapture.description: Lead-in copy while choosing the specific scrollable region to capture

selectScrollAreaToCaptureCompact.description: Narrow-viewport variant of the scroll-area selection lead-in

h2dNoScrollableAreaError.message: Select an element with vertical overflow.
h2dNoScrollableAreaError.description: Shown when the selected element is not an internally scrollable vertical region

h2dCaptureScrollAreaError.description: Fallback error message when capturing a selected scroll area fails

selectElementToCapture.description: Lead-in copy for the H2D toolbar's element-selection status row, mirroring the `Select element` action button label that opens this mode.

selectElementToCaptureCompact.description: Narrow-viewport variant of `selectElementToCapture`, swapped in below the H2D toolbar's collapse breakpoint so the status row does not clip on small screens.

selectElementShortcuts.description: Adjust-affordance copy shown after the lead-in in the H2D toolbar's element-selection status row. `<kbd>FOO</kbd>` markers render as keyboard-key chips.

selectElementShortcutsCompact.description: Narrow-viewport variant of `selectElementShortcuts`, swapped in below the H2D toolbar's collapse breakpoint. `<kbd>FOO</kbd>` markers render as keyboard-key chips.

h2dSelectElementError.description: Error message when element selection fails

h2dCapturePageError.description: Error message when capturing the page fails

h2dCopyToClipboardButton.description: Button text to copy captures as Figma layers to clipboard

h2dCopyCodeToClipboardButton.description: Label for copying an MHTML capture from the capture tray.

h2dCopyButton.description: Button text to copy all captures to clipboard

h2dCopiedText.description: Success text shown after copying to clipboard

h2dImageAssetReport.description: Aggregate result after copying a capture; counts are private and do not include asset URLs

h2dActionFailed.description: Generic fallback error text shown when a toolbar action fails unexpectedly

h2dDeleteCaptureButton.description: Aria label for the button to delete a capture

optionsFileAccessTitle.message: To capture local files, enable this setting on this extension's page:
optionsFileAccessTitle.description: Heading shown on the options page when the user tried to capture a local file:// page without file access enabled

optionsFileAccessSetting.description: Label of the (non-interactive) pill illustrating the Chrome extension setting the user must enable; mirrors the toggle on the extension's details page

optionsFileAccessCta.description: Button on the options page that opens the extension's details page where the file-access setting can be enabled

optionsFileAccessRetry.description: Secondary button on the options page that re-checks file access after the user enables it, then closes the tab so they can retry the capture

optionsFileAccessRetryHint.message: Local file access still isn't enabled
optionsFileAccessRetryHint.description: Warning banner shown when the user clicks Try again but the file-access setting is still off

optionsCapturePermissionsTitle.description: Heading shown before requesting Chrome website and clipboard permissions

optionsCapturePermissionsIntro.message: You’ll be asked to approve these permissions:
optionsCapturePermissionsIntro.description: Introduces the Chrome permissions required by the extension

optionsCapturePermissionsWebsiteTitle.description: Name of the Chrome website access permission

optionsCapturePermissionsWebsiteDescript.message: $1 allows your website to be read by the extension
optionsCapturePermissionsWebsiteDescript.description: Explains website access. $1 is the emphasized permission name.

optionsCapturePermissionsClipboardTitle.message: Modify data you copy and paste
optionsCapturePermissionsClipboardTitle.description: Name of the Chrome clipboard access permission

optionsCapturePermissionsClipboardDescri.message: $1 allows your website code to be copied to the clipboard
optionsCapturePermissionsClipboardDescri.description: Explains clipboard access. $1 is the emphasized permission name.

optionsCapturePermissionsCta.description: Requests capture permissions and resumes the originating capture when one is pending.

optionsCapturePermissionsDeniedHint.description: Warning shown when the user declines the Chrome permission prompt

optionsCaptureReadyTitle.description: Permission status shown when the options page is opened directly.

optionsCaptureReadyDescription.message: No additional permissions are currently required.
optionsCaptureReadyDescription.description: Status text on the options page when capture permissions are already enabled.

retryButton.description: Retry a local operation that could not be completed.

optionsSourceUnavailable.message: The source page is no longer available. Close this tab and try capture again from the page.
optionsSourceUnavailable.description: Shown when the original capture tab was closed or became unsupported.

optionsFigmaImportCta.description: Secondary button on the options page opening the Figma copy importer, which is never part of the capture flow.

figmaImportTitle.description: Heading of the Figma copy importer page.

figmaImportDescription.message: A design drawn on a canvas has no HTML layers to read, so it cannot be captured like a page. Figma’s own copy can, and this page keeps it: the layers survive and you can paste them into any file later.
figmaImportDescription.description: Explains why canvas content needs a different route.

figmaImportStep1.message: In Figma, select the frames or layers you want.

figmaImportStep3.message: Come back here and press Import copy from clipboard.

figmaImportCta.description: Reads the clipboard once, on click.

figmaImportSavedTitle.description: Heading over the stored Figma copies.

figmaImportCopied.message: Copied — switch to Figma and paste with Ctrl/Cmd+V.
figmaImportCopied.description: Status after re-copying a stored payload.

figmaImportStored.message: Saved. Copy it again here any time, then paste into any Figma file.

figmaImportLimited.message: The 12 most recent copies are kept; older ones are dropped.
figmaImportLimited.description: Shown when the storage cap is reached.

figmaImportPermissionNote.message: Importing reads your clipboard once, when you press the button. Nothing is read on page load and nothing leaves this browser.
figmaImportPermissionNote.description: Explains the optional clipboard read permission.

figmaImportErrorEmpty.message: Your clipboard is empty. Select layers in Figma and press Ctrl/Cmd+C first.

figmaImportErrorNotFigma.message: That clipboard content is not a Figma copy. Select layers in Figma and press Ctrl/Cmd+C, then try again.
figmaImportErrorNotFigma.description: Clipboard HTML was not a Figma scene payload.

figmaImportErrorTooLarge.message: That copy is larger than 16 MB. Copy fewer layers and try again.

figmaImportErrorDenied.message: Clipboard read access was not granted, so nothing was imported.

figmaImportErrorUnavailable.message: This browser does not allow reading rich clipboard data here.

figmaImportErrorWrite.message: Copying failed. Click the page once and try again.

figmaImportErrorStorage.message: The copy could not be stored locally. Delete an older copy and try again.

canvasCaptureToggle.description: Toolbar switch that turns the canvas strategy on or off.

canvasCaptureToggleOn.description: Switch state: native Figma copy kept on figma.com, cropped raster elsewhere.

canvasCaptureToggleOff.description: Switch state: canvases are captured exactly as the page paints them.

canvasCaptureEnabledMessage.message: Canvas capture on. On figma.com, Figma's own copy is kept so the paste is editable; elsewhere canvases copy as cropped images.
canvasCaptureEnabledMessage.description: Confirmation shown when the switch is turned on.

canvasCaptureDisabledMessage.message: Canvas capture off. Canvas regions copy exactly as the page paints them, including blank WebGL frames.
canvasCaptureDisabledMessage.description: Confirmation shown when the switch is turned off.

canvasCaptureRasterReplaced.message: Canvas region copied as an image: a blank WebGL frame was replaced with its visible pixels. Editable layers need Figma's own copy.
canvasCaptureRasterReplaced.description: Shown after a capture recovered a blank canvas.

canvasCaptureRasterResized.message: Canvas region copied as an image, scaled to Figma's 4096px paste limit. Editable layers need Figma's own copy.
canvasCaptureRasterResized.description: Shown after a capture scaled a large canvas.

canvasCaptureRasterBlank.message: Canvas region copied as an empty image: the WebGL frame could not be recovered. Editable layers need Figma's own copy.
canvasCaptureRasterBlank.description: Shown after a capture could not recover a canvas.

figmaNativeKept.message: Figma's native copy kept. Paste with Ctrl/Cmd+V for editable layers; the tray capture is the image fallback.
figmaNativeKept.description: Shown when the capture preserved Figma's native clipboard payload instead of overwriting it.

figmaNativePermission.message: The canvas was copied as an image. To keep Figma's native layers, allow clipboard read once on the extension's options page.
figmaNativePermission.description: Shown when clipboard read was refused, so the native payload could not be verified.

figmaNativeMissing.message: No Figma copy on the clipboard, so the canvas was copied as an image. Select layers in Figma, press Ctrl/Cmd+C, then capture again.
figmaNativeMissing.description: Shown when the clipboard held no Figma scene while Canvas capture was on.
